title: Old Head Stir Stick
description:
Old Head Stir Stick
The Old Head Stir Stick is a stainless steel tool with a tamp on one end and a handy stirring stick/poker on the the other.
The tamping end is designed to tamp any chamber as small as a DynaVap tip, or larger (and coincidentally works well as a tool to help set the CCDs in those tips).
Included
1 x Old Head Stir Stick
